# Frame — Acme Reports

## Problem
New managers need a dashboard to build their first report.

## Who
**Primary ICP:** new sales managers · 300 per quarter `[interview:P9]` · trigger: first forecast

## Why now
CRM vendors deprecated their report APIs in 2026-06 `[doc:vendor-changelog]`

## Riskiest assumption
New managers give up before their first report `[assumption:unvalidated]`
**Would be falsified by:** most new managers finishing a report in week one
